title: A light ：Color beacon
body:
## be careful:

This mod may not be compatible with certain rendering optimization types of mods. If the effects in the images are not present, please remove them.

![light](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4137e996eed383a07176dd1a23f79fb806e2528_0.webp)

## summary:
This mod adds three different colored beacons, each with unique rendering effects, and each beacon can be synthesized.

These light colors can be overlaid and transformed, which is why the three colors of red, green, and blue are used

They are different from the original beacon in that they can directly release a beam of light, and the beam of light is not affected by the top block.
